blocks.text: READ: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University eased to its first win in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament after downing the University of the East, 93-70, at Mall of Asia Arena on Saturday. The Tamaraws barely broke a sweat to improve to a 1-1 record while leaving the Red Warriors still searching for a win after three games. “The way we had our collapse against Adamson was not what we expected.
